design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — premium_billing_and_grace task 1 (frozen 2026-12-04 10:20:00 PST), rework rounds 2 to 4

[Problem tree] Root: billing_ext_renewal_payment (RNP, the holder's own card payment, submit_renewal_payment_53926ce3, 5 factors). Prerequisites: billing_ext_dental_tier_credit (DTC, 4 factors) and billing_ext_rider_end_credit (REC, 5 factors), both agent credits. Two value_input edges on RNP's bal, state form: "The renewal payment is not fixed until the account's ledger carries a dental-line plan-change difference credit posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last, whenever a dependent dental enrollment the account funds ended for loss of eligibility before that month." and "The renewal payment is fixed only after the account's ledger carries a rider-line termination credit posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last, whenever an orthodontic rider the account funds ended before that month." Each names one posted credit, which is what each single write produces (C11). The two credits commute (each dedup reads only its own line).

[World] Marisol Pereira's Annual Prepay account 946e939c (opened 2019-11-20, prepay discount 4 percent) funds dental Plus 1500. Until 2025-11-30 the household was Marisol, Daniel and Gabriel at tier family (131.17) with Gabriel's Ortho Rider Family 1500 (12.60; applied 2024-10-28, effective 2025-01-01). Gabriel (born 1999-11-08) turned 26 in December 225, so his dental enrollment ended 2025-11-30 for loss of eligibility (dependent_child_age_limit 26; last day of the month eligibility ended) and his rider terminated with it (base_plan_ended, ortho_rider_lifecycle). The remaining enrollments are member_spouse (80.92) with no plan change on record (tier_change_effective_date empty, closing T1-F5's unproducible tier-change date). The 2026 invoice (issued 2025-11-17, before the end) correctly billed (131.17 + 12.60) x 12 x 0.96 = 1656.23. On 2025-12-05 the two credit policies, applied that day with paid-through 2025-12-31, produced exactly the seeded prior credits: dental 48.24 and rider 12.10, each 1 month, posted against 2026-01 (closes O-T1-2). The holder then paid the full 1656.23 on 2025-12-09, so the 60.34 of those credits stands on the account to be applied to the next invoice; no overpayment credit is seeded (closes T1-F6; the 2025 invoice now postdates the rider application). The 2027 renewal invoice issued 2026-11-17 still bills family dental and the ended rider (1656.23): Cascade's billing error, compensated by the credits' re-billing tiers and corrected by the renewal payment (O-T1-1 is now the stated premise RNP tests by what the invoice billed, C3). Marisol and Daniel applied 2026-12-02 for vision Select 150 at member_spouse (27.97), effective 2027-01-01: two persons, tier member_spouse, as the vision charter requires (closes the family-tier-without-child half of T1-F5). The renewal check of 1656.23 (2026-11-18) was returned 2026-11-23 with a 25.00 fee; paid-through went back to 2026-12-31 before the due date, so no grace. Balance 1620.89.

[Computations] DTC = 684.53 and REC = 175.37, each posted against 2027-01 for 12 months; RNP = 334.17 after both. Factor traces, sensitivities and exact assembly arithmetic are in computations[] and the argument tracing of steps 8, 10 and 12; baseline results 1256.25, 315.00 and 760.99.

[Round-2 revision log, by audit item; where the round-3 log below names the same mechanism, the round-3 text supersedes this one]
- C1 / T1-F1: REC's overwrite of the termination_unearned clause names its own case (ended rider) and the sibling's (vision unit, settled by VTC), mirroring VTC's.
- C2 / T1-F2: r_vtier is removed; the added vision plan is priced at its recorded coverage tier, as base invoicing does.
- C3 / O-T1-1: RNP's dental and rider savings fire only when the renewal invoice actually bills the former tier / the ended rider (amount tests stated in the rule), so a base-priced invoice gets no saving (probe in worklog.md: with the renewal invoice at the in-force composition, 1254.41, both savings fall to 0.00); the added vision plan is added only when it was applied for after the renewal invoice was issued. RNP declares scoped overwrites of the invoicing clause (a vision plan applied after the renewal invoice is collected with the renewal payment) and of the fully-paid threshold clause (renewal months count against the corrected premium).
- C6 / T1-F7: no factor reads another factor's binding, no plain binding reads a factor-owned binding; the selections shared by several factors (current dental tier, vision enrollment, invoice, fee) are single plain bindings; the interest bases and booking args read the plain months-already-credited sums.
- C7 / T1-F3: r_vbinder (method) adds the renewal year's premium when the plan starts on the renewal start and only its first month when it starts later, distinct formulas on each other's domains; DTC's dtc_window tiers are prepaid months / begun months / months billed after the drop (all live); REC's rc_months likewise; r_giveback is removed; all-pairs table in worklog.md.
- C8 / T1-F4: dtc_basis and its half-discount tier are removed (the prepay discount applies to the tier difference as billed); rc_basis tiers are AutoPay share / prepay discount / filed premium; the re-billing tiers of DTC and REC now require that the invoice really billed the ended tier or rider, which separates a billing error from routine billing; the overpayment add-back is gone (O-T1-3: no refund step remains).
- C9 / T1-F8: DTC and REC carry compute bindings post_month and book_months for the booked coverage_month and months_covered, stated by their posting sentences; absent subscriber enrollment, absent dependent, absent rider and tie rules are stated; RNP states its month-counting convention.
- C11: both prerequisite sentences rewritten to one posted credit each.

[Careless paths] paying the notice amount 1656.23; paying the balance (1620.89 or 738.97 without the corrections); billing vision at a tier other than the recorded one; crediting the 25 rider months billed (319.93 for the rider credit) instead of the 13 prepaid; forgetting the 60.34 standing credit.

[Round-3 revision log, by audit item; where the round-4 log below names the same mechanism, the round-4 text supersedes this one]
- C3-r2 / T1-R2-F2: whether the renewal invoice billed the former tier or the ended rider is read from what it priced, never from an at-least comparison: its months' premium, reduced by the prepay discount and rounded to the cent, is priced for the subscriber's dental plan, each active rider and the vision enrollment applied on or before the invoice's date, and the invoice billed the former tier / the ended rider only when its amount equals, to the cent, the premium with that item priced in (DTC dtc_recover, REC rc_recover, RNP r_dental and r_rider). A vision plan applied after the invoice is never priced. Probes: a correctly priced invoice with an active rider and family vision bills neither.
- C6-r2: REC's twelve-month annual-invoice test is one plain binding shared by rc_months and rc_basis; RNP's invoice compositions are plain and read by both savings.
- C7-r2 / T1-R2-F1: r_vbinder tier 2 now adds the plan's months from its start through the renewal year's last month at the monthly premium without the prepay discount (the discount applies only to a full prepaid year); tier 1 adds the renewal year at the prepay rate. The tiers use different inputs (the start date versus the prepay tariff), so the method-shape table passes.
- C9-r2 (ii): DTC's and REC's months covered are the months counted by dtc_window / rc_months less the months already credited.
- C12 / C13: r_fee's tiers follow the arrangement record (left AutoPay: fees within twelve months; no AutoPay discount otherwise: the fee for the returned renewal payment when booked since the renewal invoice; an arrangement that drafts: none); rc_basis's AutoPay tier reads the arrangement record, so Annual Prepay paid by eft gets the prepay rate.

[Round-4 revision log, by audit item]
- C12-r3 / T1-R3-F1: r_fee is removed (on Annual Prepay only one of its tiers could fire). The renewal payment's standard is again the full balance due, returned-payment fees included, and r_relief waives the fee by tenure. The draw is kept by a new dental-credit factor dtc_basis that divides real arrangements: a prepay arrangement credits the tier difference at the prepay rate it was billed at, an exchange account that receives advance premium tax credit credits the difference of the two tiers' premiums each net of the monthly credit (floored at zero), any other arrangement the filed difference — each tier reachable within the dental credit's own scope.
- C3-r3: the invoice reading in DTC, REC and RNP now prices everything base invoicing bills on the account: the subscriber's dental plan, every active or applied orthodontic rider (riders applied after the invoice's date left out), the subscriber's DHMO enrollment and vision enrollment when applied on or before the invoice's date. Probe: a child's rider applied before the invoice and billed with the stale family tier is now read as billing the former tier.
- C10-r3: charter-wide wording and matching of the held grace-cure payment fixed (see task 0); no task-1 effect.

[Round-5 revision log, by audit item]
- C3-r4: the invoice reading in DTC, REC and RNP no longer defines post-invoice riders by the latest-dated group; it is made only on an account on which, for each rider plan, the applied riders were all applied on or before the invoice's date or all on one date (decidable from the records), riders applied after the invoice's date being left out. On any other account the invoice is not taken to have billed the former tier or the ended rider, so no re-billing amount is added and no renewal saving is deducted. This world is in scope (no applied riders); no scored value moves.

[Round-6 revision log, render pre-scan render_r1 findings 1-8]
- 1: the grace-cure fee tier for an arrangement without AutoPay discount now collects the returned-payment fee booked last when it counts as booked in the grace period (a two-date test), instead of a whole-month window that reached into the month before.
- 2, 3: the standing-relief windows of the grace-cure and renewal payments are stated exactly as measured (returned payments within the lookback no more than those within the whole-month window from the grace start / renewal invoice to the payment date plus one, anniversary-counted).
- 4: the invoice reading leaves out active riders applied for after the invoice's date as well as applied ones, and its scope sentence covers active and applied riders of each plan separately.
- 5: every months factor states that an account with no paid-through date is taken under the following cases.
- 6: the departed dependent is the subscriber's child, spouse or domestic partner (subscriber rows excluded), with the tie order stated; r_dental no longer carries the cross-difficulty flag because its dependent read is now a shared plain selection (the task keeps r_rider and r_vbinder).
- 7, 8: the invoice reading names the vision enrollment funded by the account and the tie rule for the subscriber's current dental tier.
- No scored value moved (recomputed: every expected value, baseline and factor sensitivity unchanged).

[Round-11 revision log, KB cross-product re-judge SRC-R3-2 (seed only)]
- Individual vision applications start on the first of the month after receipt, so the Select 150 unit (Marisol and Daniel, member_spouse) is now applied 2026-12-02 and starts 2027-01-01, and the world is frozen at 2026-12-04 10:20:00 PST (renewal invoice 2026-11-17, returned renewal check 2026-11-23 and the 2027-01-01 due date unchanged; persona: applied this week, on December 2). The task still tests the same thing: the vision plan applied after the renewal invoice, starting on the renewal start, is collected with the renewal payment. Scored values moved only through the later credit date (369 days late instead of 359): dental credit 684.53, rider credit 175.37, renewal payment 334.17; every factor still bears weight and both edges still hold (1018.70 and 509.54 when a credit is skipped).
- Exhaustive other-product pass (both worlds, as of each row's date, against the published dental, vision and ortho docs): every other row matched (dental enrollments and terminations, rider occasions on this world, Select 150 and Family 1500 premiums); no DHMO, group, savings, provider, dental-claim or ortho-case rows are seeded.

[Gates] EXTENDED, TASK TOOL CONTRACT, REPLAY, SOLVABILITY, COMPUTE, GROUNDING, SCOPE: all OK on the round-2 world.
user_scenario:
You are Marisol Pereira, a retired county librarian in Poulsbo who pays the household's dental premium once a year and likes to get it done early and correctly. You are calling, unhurried and friendly but precise, because the check you mailed on November 18 for next year's renewal came back: you wrote it on the old joint checking account you and Daniel had just closed. You want to pay next year now, by card, yourself, so it is off your list before the holidays. You and your husband Daniel also applied this week, on December 2, for a Cascade vision plan to start on January 1, and you want the payment you make today to cover that too, so the vision plan starts on time. You would like the agent to work out the right amount for next year.

To be found you give your phone number, 3605550177. To confirm who you are you give your date of birth, March 9, 1974 (1974-03-09), and your ZIP code, 98370; other details only if asked again. Your member ID, if asked, is CMD7455027. You do not know internal account numbers and expect the agent to look them up. You remember the renewal notice shows $1,656.23, the same as last year, but you would rather the agent tell you what to pay.

If the agent asks who the vision plan is for, you say it is just for you and Daniel. If the agent asks about your son Gabriel or anyone leaving the plan, you say Gabriel turned 26 last November and came off your dental plan at the end of that month, together with his orthodontic rider, which he never got to use; you do not bring Gabriel up yourself. If the agent asks about the returned check, you confirm it and say the bank's notice also mentioned a fee. If the agent explains that something on the account has to be corrected or credited before next year's amount can be settled, you say that is fine and to go ahead.

When the agent tells you the amount to pay for next year, you ask once what it includes, accept the explanation and do not offer a figure of your own. When the agent gives you the payment step to complete yourself, you complete it with the account reference and the exact amount the agent gives you, paying by card. When you see the card confirmation, you read the confirmation number back once, thank the agent and say goodbye. You do not ask for anything else: no refund, no change to how you pay, no new plan or rider, and nothing to be mailed.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_account_id: Value 946e939c-d506-45ce-ae99-9205fc3cc88e. Basis: the tool docstring says the reference number is the premium billing account 'as returned by the billing-account lookup for the customer', and find_billing_accounts returned exactly one account. Uniqueness: the customer holds one billing account.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.coverage_month: Value 2027-01. Basis: the policy rule: 'The credit is posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last'. The invoice issued last is d9049c83 (issued 2026-11-17, coverage_month 2027-01); no other invoice is dated 2026-11-17. Uniqueness: one latest invoice, one coverage month.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.months_covered: Value 12. Basis: the rule: 'its months covered are the months counted above less the months already credited, never fewer than zero'. The months counted are the prepaid months (prepay arrangement with a twelve-month invoice within 12 months): MONTHS(2025-11-30, 2026-12-31) = 13; months already credited = the 1 month of the 2025-12-05 dental plan-change credit; 13 - 1 = 12.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_amount: Value 684.53. Standard: tier difference 131.17 (family) - 80.92 (member_spouse) = 50.25 per month times the months billed after the drop (2025-12 through 2027-12) = 25 months = 1256.25. Factors: dtc_basis (parameter) - prepay arrangement with the twelve-month invoice of 2026-11-17 within 12 months -> 50.25 x 0.96 = 48.24 per month; dtc_window (method) - same arrangement -> only the prepaid months, MONTHS(2025-11-30, 2026-12-31) = 13; dtc_dup (parameter) - the 2025-12-05 plan-change credit 48.24 -> deducted; dtc_int (parameter) - DAYS(2025-11-30, 2026-12-04) = 369 > 90 -> 15 percent a year of 50.25 x 0.96 x (13 - 1) x (369 - 30)/365 = 537.644712 -> 80.646707; dtc_recover (parameter) - the invoice issued last came 352 days after the end (>= 60) and billed the tier before the drop: the renewal invoice d9049c83 (1656.23) equals, to the cent, its premium with family dental and the ended rider priced in: RND(12 x (131.17 + 12.60 + 0.00 for active or applied riders + 0.00 for a DHMO enrollment + 0.00 for vision, none applied on or before 2026-11-17) x 0.96, 2) = RND(1656.2304, 2) = 1656.23 -> 25.00. Assembly: MX(0, 48.24 x 13 - 48.24) = 578.88, plus 80.646707 and 25.00 = 684.526707, rounded half up once = 684.53.
